test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Jitesh and Kamal can complete a certain piece of work in 5 and 18 days, respectively, They started to work together, and after 3 days, Kamal left. In how many days will Jitesh complete the remaining work?
solution:
**Given:**

Jitesh = 5 days, Kamal = 18 days, worked together = 3 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = LCM(5, 18) = 90 units

Efficiency = Total work ÷ Time

Time = Work ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ Jitesh’s efficiency = 90 ÷ 5 = 18 units/day

⇒ Kamal’s efficiency = 90 ÷ 18 = 5 units/day

⇒ Together (3 days) = (18 + 5) × 3 = 23 × 3 = 69 units

⇒ Remaining work = 90 − 69 = 21 units

⇒ Time for Jitesh alone = 21 ÷ 18 = 7/6 days

**∴ Jitesh needs 7/6 days.**
